newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania expects S&P rating today.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania expects S&P rating today.

text.p: Lithuanian Finance Minister Algirdas Shemeta said on Friday that he was expecting rating agency Standard and Poor's to announce its rating for the country later today.
"The results should be announced today," Shemeta told Reuters.
"But we have no information about whether or not their committee has gathered," he added.
He declined to make any further comment before the results are announced.
The rating is regarded as crucial to the success of Lithuania's forthcoming $200 million eurobond issue.
Lithuania acquired its first rating last fall from Moody's, and received a BB plus long-term foreign currency rating earlier this year from IBCA.
